annotation.title_clean: Protocolo ante Contingencias de Indisponibilidad de los Servicios Informáticos del Poder Judicial de Santa Fe
annotation.title_en: Protocol for Contingencies of Unavailability of IT Services of the Judiciary of Santa Fe
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Corte Suprema de Justicia de la Provincia de Santa Fe
annotation.venue: Poder Judicial de Santa Fe (Circular Nro 25)
annotation.summary_en: Santa Fe Supreme Court resolution approving a protocol for continuity of judicial services when IT systems become unavailable, e.g. through cyberattacks. It sets paper-based filing and notification fallbacks, instructs staff to power off and disconnect equipment, and lets the Court direct gradual restoration. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Paper filings with handwritten signature when SISFE/Autoconsulta Online is unavailable
Court offices receive paper filings and record date and time
Staff must power off and disconnect IT equipment from the network on activation
Supreme Court decides gradual restoration and the protocol's duration
Dissemination and training on the protocol required
